sentences.text: 8. Issue notice.
9. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
Considering the nature and gravity of the offence involved, he opposes the bail application and seeks time to file a Status Report.

10. Since the prosecutrix/ complainant is present in the Court today along with her mother and her counsel, there is no requirement of issuing notice under Section 439(1-A) Cr.P.C read with Delhi High Court Practice Directions dated 24.09.2019.
11.

Before adverting into the merits of the case, on a specific query made by this Court, the prosecutrix/ complainant submits that she is willing to compromise the disputes inter se herself and the applicant herein, who happens to be her husband, as she does not wish to pursue the criminal proceedings against the applicant and has no objection, if bail is granted to the applicant.
She further affirms that in fact she will soon be taking appropriate steps to enter into a formal written settlement.
12. In any event, she further submits that she will be making an appropriate statement before the learned Trial Court, where the matter is already listed on 31.10.2023.
13. In view thereof, it is clear that the complainant/ prosecutrix present in Court has herself stated that she is willing to compromise the disputes This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/10/2023 at 00:17:55 inter se herself and the applicant herein, who happens to be her husband because she does not wish to pursue the criminal proceedings against the applicant and further as she has no objection, if bail is granted to the applicant and will be taking appropriate steps in this regard.

Accordingly, without adverting to the merits of the matter, though the Court is mindful of the gravity and heinousness of the offence involved, however, upon consideration of the existing peculiar facts and the overall events unfolding in their entirety, as there are rare circumstances involved herein, in the considered opinion of this Court, this is a fit case for grant of bail.
14. Considering the same, there is no requirement for the Status Report to be filed.
Similarly, in the considered opinion of this Court, there is no requirement for the Nominal Roll to be requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent.

15. Accordingly, the present application is allowed and the applicant be released on regular bail in FIR No.489/2021 dated 10.07.2021 under Sections 376/354/406/34 IPC read with Sections 4/8/21 of the POCSO Act, 2012 and Sections 9/10/11 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 at PS.
